cwe_content.cwe: CWE-683,Function Call With Incorrect Order of Arguments

candidate.Code:
def lookup_internal_function(self, method_name, args_ir, ast_source):
        sig = self.sigs["self"].get(method_name, None)
        def _check(cond, s="Unreachable"):
            if not cond:
                raise CompilerPanic(s)
        _check(sig is not None)
        _check(sig.internal)
        _check(len(sig.base_args) <= len(args_ir) <= len(sig.args))
        num_provided_kwargs = len(args_ir) - len(sig.base_args)
        num_kwargs = len(sig.default_args)
        kwargs_needed = num_kwargs - num_provided_kwargs
        kw_vals = list(sig.default_values.values())[:kwargs_needed]
        return sig, kw_vals
candidate.Reason: The function processes default arguments left-to-right instead of right-to-left, which can lead to incorrect argument ordering and type checking bypass when types are incompatible. This matches the described vulnerability of incorrect default argument handling in internal calls.
